notes.title: Oceanside City Siege Update
notes.content:
Welcome Medieval fans,

[h3]Since the premiere, we have been working on fixing the game and listening to the voice of the community. At last, we have prepared for you, the first update "[b]Oceanside City Siege[/b]"[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/033510ff5c69be8b5fa7849843b5cf726f267a67.png[/img]

If you still haven't got the game. Today you can get 20% off.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584680/Medieval_Machines_Builder/

[h3]Here is what you get in the update:[/h3]

[b]Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A brand new level with a new machine to build - the Siege Tower
[*] New crafting recipes and items
[*] New music tracks
[*] New sound effects for interactions and destruction
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Quality of life changes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/a12ca85035eb93053fbfbc8ef5de2103286ab005.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/308eb9fd0d0c38f57335ebb9bb89d0973a3b579a.jpg[/img]

[b]New Level - Oceanside City:[/b]

The siege of this city has taken a few weeks now but without any success. Your mission this time, is to sneak into the siege camp and build a mighty siege tower. The siege camp's resources are scarce, so you must use anything at your disposal to finish the construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/0d811cc1d349f30f05099d3354c03c910444a126.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/3e259f0e55a6d03b5d0ea943f11670abd76808cd.jpg[/img]

[b]The level features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Medieval Machine™ to build - the mighty Siege Tower!
[*] A day and night cycle:
[*] A huge machine takes a long time to build - spend 4 days working on the construction
[*] As happens during a war, the nights may not be as peaceful as you'd like...
[*] New music to get you in the right mood
[*] Naturally, a siege tower has multiple floors - you need to climb ladders to get to the higher ones!
[*] Multiple story events happening throughout the construction
[*] New letters from the council that you will surely read!
[*] Our engineers now have some thoughts of their own - inspect some curious items and objects on the level and take a peek into their mind
[*] Speak to the knights living in the camp and hear their gossip and weirdly philosophical thoughts
[*] Meet with an old friend, whose wagon is in trouble again...
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/db25af1a07481da8f9f5d1534e2de9b369b81246.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/5a8da5ad94a567d8b16d689e773de19bfdb1dcb1.jpg[/img]

You can find the new level at the top of the map, by the ocean. It unlocks after finishing the Riverlands level, where you construct the trebuchet.

[b]QOL changes:[/b]
- You can now disable head bob in the settings
- Changing FOV now changes the setting in different view modes (no more "dynamic FOV")
- You can now disable the missile camera in the settings (the camera won't follow the missile after shooting)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/3bf5f6870efc6e9d9387cb0479febb2885090cd1.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- The toggle boxes in the settings menu should now always correctly display their state
- Translation updates in a few languages
- And many, many smaller fixes...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/2d258761a94f8b7ebcbcfdf9c1c0519f3b997be7.jpg[/img]

We are waiting for your feedback. 

Have fun
Medieval Machines Builder team

notes.content:

notes.title: Medieval Machines in Action
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, medieval fans,[/h2]

[h3]Today we want to bring you some new information about what exactly can you expect from Medieval Machines Builder![/h3]
 
[h3][b]Constructing the Battering Ram![/b][/h3]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExam54bGJvb3BodWMyMWhsZThmMGNoN3M0NHc2cjV2ejA1bzR5eWhiZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/FVPC71ByleanJvdk2C/giphy.gif[/img]
 
Battering rams were used in almost every siege of castles and fortresses due to their simple construction. The long beam, which served as the central point of the construction, was often reinforced at the front to prevent its rapid destruction. If the beam was exceptionally heavy, it was suspended on scaffolding to make it manageable for use. The entire structure was enclosed and reinforced to protect the soldiers inside. Altogether, it created the appearance of a shed on wheels.
In our game, you will be able to construct this machine step by step and then put it into action!
 
 
[h3][b]Observe the beauty of medieval engineering in action![/b][/h3]

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdjhrdTRxd3FsYzI3cjZ5M244ODNjd3M0dDA4eWdrN2hrNzlrcXFhYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/eUXEimMuKPxpTJVkFV/giphy.gif[/img]
 
We are working on perfecting all the animations of available machines. This is what the new, improved animation for the trebuchet looks like! We also changed the textures used for it.
When playing the game, building a machine won’t be your only mission. Many times you will have to operate your constructions and use it to tip the scales of victory in your favor!

[h3][b]A riddle for medieval fans[/b][/h3]

What movie is this scene (one of the most famous scenes using a [b]trebuchet[/b]) from?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y4tRN2i.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Brand New Level available for Playtesting![/b][/h3]
 
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbG0zc2V2dHZuYWkzY3MyNWo3ZW9oYXFtMWdkazE4ZGllYmF1N3g3bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/i4cK0reyb4VWLRtLCa/giphy.gif[/img]
 
Your task here will be simple: train and sharpen your skills in operating a catapult. You will need to destroy as much of the village as possible. Take your time here and see for yourself the destructive potential of engineering.
 
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa2F6emR5ajZyYTVuenNtOW85Y2NsaXc1bThscWc0d3NiN202enFpZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/sdW8TkSAV9ytKieqr8/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Medieval Catapult
notes.content:
[h3]Well met, medieval fans,[/h3]
 
This time, as August comes to an end, we want to share with you what you can expect in the upcoming weeks.
We have plans to introduce a new level for you to experience during our [b]Playtests[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/ef9bc64cec8d88f7b216699036ddde3f57e5e06b.png[/img]


Here you will be able to try for yourself how it feels to have hands-on experience with operating a medieval Catapult and wreaking havoc on the proving ground that has been prepared for this very purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40193299/e6841c76c20565312757075a06dcb996f54b965e.png[/img]

Hope you will have a great deal of fun witnessing the destructive power of Medieval Machines in action!
